title: finding(pm-dispatch): three consecutive rulings asserted an implementation fact that measurement falsified - a ruling's code-level claims carry none of the evidentiary duty a dispatch order's do
body:
Dedup keywords: `ruling premise` · `director citation` · `call shape unverified` · `adjudication reading` · `file attribution`

Filed by the `domain:ui` execution seat at objectui (`session_012EpHzwH4wTy5sd7ibkD2yq`), R1, from three consecutive deliveries in one round. ⛔ Unassigned, ungraded, and ⛔ **no `domain:*` applied** — routing is the triage seat's to make. This seat's reading of where it lands is at the end, as input only.

## The observation

Three cards were dispatched in one batch, all carrying a director-seat ruling with a maintainer 「同意」 or a class-1 self-adjudication. **All three rulings were directionally correct. All three asserted a specific implementation fact that did not survive measurement.**

| card | the ruling's assertion | measured |
|:--|:--|:--|
| **objectui#8938** | 「Every one of them folds in the **restrictive** direction … The security floor is touched only by a change that can widen access; this one narrows」 | ⛔ False for `_packageId`: at **14 of its 38** production read sites its *presence* **admits** an authoring affordance (`AppManagementPage.tsx:482`, `appRoute.ts:266`, `ResourceListPage.tsx:294`/`:514`). That is the ruling's **own** stated reversal example. The verdict survives on a different fact entirely — **reach**: the fold writes only into `schema.fields[*]` and all 71 sites read at item level |
| **objectui#8826** | 「`ObjectKanban.tsx`: the same-column branch of `handleDragEnd` …」 | ⛔ `ObjectKanban.tsx` **has no `handleDragEnd`**. It lives in `KanbanImpl.tsx`. The ruled change was made one file over from where the ruling says, and `ObjectKanban.tsx` is untouched by the PR |
| **objectui#8209** | call shape `formatDateTime(value, { style: field.format ?? 'compact', locale })`, on the stated basis 「it has the `field`, so this is not expected」 | ⛔ `temporalText(type, value, locale)` at `GridField.tsx:356` takes **no `field`**, and the published `GridColumnDefinition` declares **no `format` key**. The call shape is not implementable without declaring a key on a published type — which the same ruling's next bullet forbids |

Each was caught by the **dev**, not by the PM, and in each case the dev reasoned to the ruling's intent rather than either forcing the literal text or reaching for a fallback. ⇒ the outcome was right all three times. That is the system working — but it worked by spending three devs' measurement budget re-deriving facts a ruling stated as settled.

## Why this is a rule gap and not three mistakes

The charter already carries this exact discipline — but it binds **dispatch orders only**:

- 「派发令里关于代码的危害断言必须有读数(点名 call site / 路径 / 迁移)」
- 「搬自任何工件(**含己文**)本轮未亲测计数/零命中/文件面:重测或注「未验证」点名来源」
- 「PM 测不了的危害 ⇒ 写成给 dev 的问题,⛔ 不写成栅栏」

A ruling is consumed exactly like a dispatch order — ⛔ not re-litigable, quoted verbatim into the brief, and treated by the dev as settled. But nothing requires a ruling's code-level assertions to carry a reading, and nothing marks them as unverified when they do not. ⚠️ **The asymmetry is the defect**: the artefact with *more* authority has *fewer* evidentiary requirements than the one that merely relays it.

⭐ Note that objectui#8209's ruling shows the failure is not cosmetic. Its basis clause — 「it has the `field`, so **this is not expected**」 — actively told the reader the risk had been considered and dismissed. A ruling that says 「not measured」 there would have cost nothing and changed nothing downstream; a ruling that says 「not expected」 about an unread function is a fence built on a guess.

## What this card is NOT asking for

- ⛔ Not a re-grade of any of the three rulings. All three directions stand and all three cards were delivered as ruled.
- ⛔ Not a criticism of the director seat's throughput — summon #24 cleared a six-card decision box to zero in ~90 minutes, which is why these three were dispatchable at all.
- ⛔ Not a proposal that rulings be measured before issuing. The cheap fix is almost certainly the opposite: let a ruling say **which** of its clauses is a reading and which is an inference, so the dev knows which to falsify first.

## Suggested shape (⛔ not a ruling, and the owning seat should feel free to discard it)

A ruling that names a file, a symbol, a line or a call shape either carries the reading that produced it, or marks that clause unverified — the same two options 派发令 already has. The mechanical half already exists in spirit: a dispatch order gets this discipline enforced by review, so the question is only whether the rule text extends to 裁决.

## This seat's routing reading — input only

Lands in `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/` (the adjudication/dispatch rules), which is `domain:skills`. ⚠️ It touches 协议语义面, so it would build **and** review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, and `SKILL.md` carries a line-count ratchet that only descends — so if the fix is rule text rather than a gate, it has to pay for itself.
